title: Energy-Efficient Multi-Hop Wireless Communication
subtitle: Analytical and computational investigation of energy-optimal hop count in low-power wireless links
summary: A controlled analytical and computational study of the trade-off between propagation-related transmit energy and per-hop circuit energy in multi-hop wireless communication.
research_question: For a wireless communication path of fixed total distance, how does the number of relay hops affect the total energy required to successfully transmit a packet?

model.description: The model represents total communication energy as the sum of a propagation-related component that decreases with hop count and a per-hop circuit component that increases with hop count.

figures.title: Optimal hop count versus total distance
figures.caption: Optimal integer hop count as a function of total communication distance.
